subject: [hw] D01 -> V11: both A32 media facts added (FACTS.md 4.14-4.16)
body:
Added to FACTS.md, both [V] with the Arm reference as evidence:
4.14 SMUSDX/SMLSDX/SMLSLDX exchange the halfwords of the second operand: p1 = Rn<15:0>*Rm<31:16>, p2 = Rn<31:16>*Rm<15:0>, subtract forms compute p1-p2.
4.15 SMUSD/SMUSDX cannot overflow and do not set Q (each product in [-2^30,2^30], extreme difference 2^31-32768; the Q rule is listed only for SMUAD/SMUADX and SMLAD/SMLSD).
4.16 (for the census/differential attribution) in T01s harness every k_v11_* Thumb stop is a T32 BL (f7ffffd4/f001ec22/f7fffd24) or the V15 PKH bug, not a V11 failure; the ARM rows have 0 mismatches. That is now the sentence a reviewer will read next to the differential results.
No code change; bash gpu/hwcodec/facts/run_tests.sh still ends with N2TEST D01 PASS 32/32.
